picks.editorial_note: An AI model (Omnii) designed a bacteriophage used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection — a genuine proof point that generative AI can produce real therapeutics, not just predictions.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's AI-based imaging technique independently confirmed the iconic 2019 Event Horizon Telescope black hole image in a Nature publication, validating one of astrophysics' most famous results through an entirely new method.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: MIT and UBC researchers built WorldParticle, a single deep-learning model that unifies simulation of wildly different physical phenomena — from sand to protein folding — a notable step toward general-purpose physics AI.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's scandal and its national-security implications touch the company at the center of the global AI compute supply chain, raising real policy and export-control concerns.
picks.title: Nvidia CEO’s scandal raises questions about US national security

picks.editorial_note: A $53M ARPA-H award to an MIT-led team to use generative AI for discovering safer herbicide alternatives is a substantial federal bet on AI-driven chemistry with direct agricultural and public-health stakes.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: Atos and Inria's strategic partnership to commercialize sovereign AI, robotics, and cybersecurity research reflects a growing push by European governments and industry to reduce dependence on non-domestic AI infrastructure.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with robotics maker Unitree, building toward a joint lab, signals deepening academia-industry integration in embodied AI, a fast-growing and strategically important robotics subfield.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: A $19M state grant to Texas Tech for an AI-integrated computing cluster for semiconductor R&D underscores how AI and advanced chip manufacturing are becoming inseparable strategic priorities.
picks.title: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation | Texas Tech Now

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and Carnegie Mellon researchers' new 'Workspace Models' memory architecture lets robots recall past observations cheaply, addressing a core bottleneck in making robots practically capable over time.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: A $5M NSF grant led by the University of Georgia to build an open radio access network for AI-optimized extended reality shows continued federal investment in AI-driven next-generation wireless infrastructure.
picks.title: $5M NSF grant to grow extended reality technologies
